meaning: Project name
valid_range_or_values: Signal-Android
modeling_notes: Constant in this pilot.

meaning: CSIQ annual snapshot label
modeling_notes: version_t1 is the consecutive next snapshot, not a calendar interpolation.

meaning: Top-level type identity
valid_range_or_values: Java-style qualified name with lowercase parent package segment
modeling_notes: Exact string match across versions. Rename looks like death+birth.

meaning: Row-kind from QualifiedName shape
valid_range_or_values: top_level only in these files
modeling_notes: Inner/nested, anonymous, method, field, package rows were excluded.

meaning: Weighted Method Count (first WMC column)
valid_range_or_values: non-negative numeric
missingness_meaning: empty if the quality cell was non-numeric
modeling_notes: Viable lagged outcome. Do not put cyclomatic/NCSS PMD rules on the RHS.

meaning: WMC_t1 - WMC_t
valid_range_or_values: numeric difference
missingness_meaning: empty if either WMC is missing
modeling_notes: Not 'software corrosion'. Zero is common and is a real measured value, not missingness.

meaning: Size, coupling, method-count controls at t
source: quality first LOC, CBO, NOM columns
valid_range_or_values: numeric
modeling_notes: Candidate controls. NOM collinear with TooManyMethods (not used). CBO collinear with CouplingBetweenObjects (not used).

meaning: Same metrics at t+1
valid_range_or_values: numeric
modeling_notes: Not default RHS. Stored so WMC_t1 can be checked against the subsequent version file.

meaning: 1 if this class key appears in that version's PMD CSV
valid_range_or_values: 0 or 1
missingness_meaning: never missing; 0 means unknown, not clean
modeling_notes: Restrict first models to 1, or treat 0 as out-of-scope. Never recode 0 as 'no smell'.

meaning: All design.xml violation rows for this class key, all rules
valid_range_or_values: integer >= 1 when known
modeling_notes: Diagnostic. Includes non-candidate rules such as cyclomatic thresholds.

meaning: PMD DataClass violation count (Data Class)
valid_range_or_values: integer >= 0 when known; empty when unknown
missingness_meaning: empty iff status_known=0. Empty is unknown, not zero.
modeling_notes: Count is 0 only when PMD observed the class and this rule had no violation.

meaning: Whether this construct's count is identified from a PMD class key
source: same as smell_status_known; one PMD export covers all six constructs
valid_range_or_values: 0 or 1; identical to smell_status_known in this dataset
modeling_notes: Redundant with smell_status_known given a single design.xml dump. Kept so a construct is never silently treated as observed.
